objective.name: structure.delete
objective.description: Delete one local structure descriptor and remove it from the runtime catalog.

#root.role: Resolve one structure identifier, remove the local structure descriptor, and delete its runtime catalog entry.

effects.structure_descriptor: The local structure file is removed best-effort.
effects.catalog: The local structure catalog entry is removed.

transformation_contract.morphing: A structure identifier becomes an explicit deletion of the corresponding local structure descriptor and catalog entry.
invariants: structure.delete operates on one local catalog identity only.
Runtime catalog presence is authoritative for deletion eligibility.
success: On success, structure.delete returns ok=true and echoes the deleted structure_id.
Successful deletion removes the structure from the runtime catalog even when filesystem cleanup is only best-effort.
failure: The capacity fails when structure_id is missing.
The capacity refuses deletion when the structure is absent from the runtime catalog.
notes: Deletion is local to the current context.
The runtime catalog remains the source of truth for local structure existence.
